definitions.explanation: A fish shortly after hatching, before it has grown to adult form. Common in talk of fish farming, river restocking and aquarium keeping.

examples.japanese: {稚魚|ちぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放流|ほうりゅう}→放流：18495_houryuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To release fry into the river.
Salmon fry are swimming in the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水温|すいおん}→水温：27380_suion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{稚魚|ちぎょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{育|そだ}たない→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If the water gets too warm, the fry sometimes fail to grow properly.
